packs.name: 来源教程证明链
packs.layout_rule: 先给结果，再给来源，再给操作，最后汇聚成可复制步骤。

layout_contract.grid_system: 12-column canvas grid with 72px outer margin and 24px minimum inner padding
layout_contract.three_column_rule: When using three_column_aligned_checklist, columns must share equal width, identical icon center y, title baseline y, body box y, and bottom summary safe gap.
layout_contract.text_fit_rule: Measure text before render; wrap first, shrink only within approved min size, then shorten copy if it still does not fit.
layout_contract.collision_rule: Decorative lines, connector paths, glow strokes, and captions must not cross title, body, topic, subtitle, or cover text boxes.

packs.name: 新闻到小白行动
packs.layout_rule: 先锁来源，再翻译成人话，再给小白一个今天能做的动作。

layout_contract.grid_system: source card left, human translation center, action checklist right, all anchored to a shared baseline grid
layout_contract.three_column_rule: Do not hand-place three steps; use measured equal-width slots and shared baselines.
layout_contract.text_fit_rule: Beginner copy must be shortened before reducing below the minimum readable font size.
layout_contract.collision_rule: Source citations, captions, and action chips must stay outside the lower subtitle safe band.

packs.name: 多 Skill 生产栈
packs.layout_rule: 每个工具必须说明任务、输入、输出和边界，不做工具名堆砌。

layout_contract.grid_system: stack map rows use fixed track heights; tool/input/output/boundary columns use equal baselines
layout_contract.three_column_rule: For three tools or three steps, use locked tracks with equal icon, title, and body baselines.
layout_contract.text_fit_rule: Tool names can stay English, but explanations must wrap inside measured Chinese text boxes.
layout_contract.collision_rule: Animated connector paths may connect module sockets only and must not cross readable text.

packs.name: 可保存清单模板
packs.layout_rule: 全片围绕一张可保存清单，不追求复杂证明墙。

layout_contract.grid_system: checklist rows or three-column checklist must use fixed coordinates, equal gaps, and measured text slots
layout_contract.three_column_rule: Three-step recaps must align number circle center y, title baseline, body text box, and bottom summary line.
layout_contract.text_fit_rule: Each column body is max two lines; if longer, shorten copy before render.
layout_contract.collision_rule: Bottom summary must keep at least 48px from the card border and 96px from subtitles.

packs.name: 模型能力对比
packs.layout_rule: 左右双通道保持对称，只点亮正在讲的一侧，避免红绿大卡片。

layout_contract.grid_system: two comparison columns with mirrored widths and fixed caption-safe lower band
layout_contract.three_column_rule: Use three columns only for final recaps, never for dense model specs.
layout_contract.text_fit_rule: Comparison labels must fit one line; body copy wraps into measured rows.
layout_contract.collision_rule: Highlight strokes and dividers must remain outside text bounding boxes.

packs.name: 竖版无人声推荐
packs.layout_rule: 竖版每屏只讲一个工具或一个步骤，文字少、节奏快、避开抖音安全区。

layout_contract.grid_system: vertical safe-zone grid with right operation rail and bottom title guard
layout_contract.three_column_rule: Do not use three columns in vertical mode; use stacked steps.
layout_contract.text_fit_rule: Vertical captions use short labels and measured two-line max.
layout_contract.collision_rule: All text avoids Douyin right-side operation rail and bottom title area.
